subject: a tall dignified African American man of the mid 1800s with a strong jaw, thick wavy dark hair swept back from a side part, a full beard, and a steady, serious gaze, wearing a dark frock coat, white high-collared shirt and dark cravat

panels.01-tuckahoe: a small log cabin at the edge of woods on Maryland's Eastern Shore around 1818, a grandmother in a simple head wrap sitting on the doorstep holding a baby wrapped in a blanket, tall pines, river in the distance, morning light, peaceful and tender
panels.02-letters: a determined African American boy of about twelve in plain 1830 work clothes sitting on a Baltimore wharf step, tracing letters with chalk on a wooden board, a worn school book open on his knee, ships' masts and brick warehouses behind him, golden afternoon light
panels.03-sabbath: a young African American man teaching a small group of African American men and women of different ages to read from a few worn books by candlelight in a simple wooden cabin, 1834 rural Maryland, faces lit with focus and hope, quiet and secret
panels.04-train: a young African American man of about twenty dressed as a sailor in a red shirt, loose black cravat and flat sailor's hat, sitting upright and calm in a wooden 1838 railway passenger car, steam locomotive smoke and Maryland countryside passing outside the window, quiet courage, tension and resolve
panels.05-nantucket: a tall young African American man of 23, clean-shaven, with thick dark hair swept back, in a plain dark coat and white collar, standing up to speak for the first time at a crowded 1841 meeting in a plain wooden New England hall, sunlight through tall windows, the audience leaning forward, a moment of courage
panels.06-northstar: {S} in an 1847 printing shop in Rochester, inspecting a freshly printed newspaper page beside a hand-operated iron printing press, type cases and ink rollers around him, a young assistant setting type, lamplight, pride in work
panels.07-lincoln: {S} meeting a tall thin bearded American president in a black suit in a modest 1863 White House office, both standing and shaking hands across a desk covered with papers and maps, serious respectful conversation, gaslight
panels.08-cedarhill: {S} as an elderly man with white hair and a white beard, sitting in a book-lined study at his hilltop home Cedar Hill in Washington D.C. in the late 1870s, reading by a window with a view over the Anacostia river to the city, calm dignity
